record.original_question: Given positive integers d_1, ..., d_k with k + 2 <= sum_i d_i <= n + k, is a general complete intersection of multidegree (d_1, ..., d_k) K-stable?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n \geq 1$ and $k \geq 1$ be integers, and let $d_1, \ldots, d_k$ be positive integers satisfying
$$k + 2 \;\le\; \sum_{i=1}^{k} d_i \;\le\; n + k.$$
A complete intersection of multidegree $(d_1, \ldots, d_k)$ in $\mathbb{P}^{n+k}$ is the scheme-theoretic intersection $X = H_1 \cap \cdots \cap H_k \subset \mathbb{P}^{n+k}$ of $k$ hypersurfaces $H_i$ of degree $d_i$ that meet transversally; such an $X$ is a smooth $n$-dimensional Fano variety with $-K_X = \mathcal{O}_X(n + k + 1 - \sum_i d_i)$ when the inequality is strict, and a smooth Calabi–Yau-type boundary case is excluded. (The lower bound $\sum d_i \geq k+2$ excludes projective spaces and quadrics, and the upper bound $\sum d_i \leq n+k$ ensures $X$ is Fano.)

Prove that, for every such tuple $(d_1, \ldots, d_k)$, a general complete intersection of multidegree $(d_1, \ldots, d_k)$ in $\mathbb{P}^{n+k}$ is K-stable.

Here K-stability is the algebro-geometric notion characterizing existence of Kähler–Einstein metrics on smooth Fano varieties: $X$ is K-stable if for every nontrivial test configuration $(\mathcal{X}, \mathcal{L}) \to \mathbb{A}^1$ for $(X, -K_X)$ with reduced central fiber, the generalized Donaldson–Futaki invariant $\mathrm{DF}(\mathcal{X}, \mathcal{L})$ is strictly positive (equivalently, by Fujita–Li, the stability threshold satisfies $\delta(X) > 1$).
artifact.status_search_result: K-stability of general Fano complete intersections is known only in restricted ranges. Zhuang and others established K-stability for index-1 Fano complete intersections via birational superrigidity, and K-stability of smooth Fano hypersurfaces of index 2 has been proved. For general multidegrees with $k+2 \le \sum d_i \le n+k$, however, K-stability of a general complete intersection remains open in higher dimensions, and surveys describe the higher-dimensional case as largely unresolved.

status_evidence.title: K-stability of Fano Varieties: An Algebro-Geometric Approach
status_evidence.snippet: Very little is known in higher dimension regarding K-stability of Fano complete intersections.
status_evidence.claim: The general K-stability question for Fano complete intersections in higher dimension is largely open.

status_evidence.title: [2003.13788] K-stability of Fano varieties via admissible flags
status_evidence.snippet: Existence of Kähler–Einstein metrics is proved for all smooth Fano hypersurfaces of Fano index two.
status_evidence.claim: Only special index/degree ranges have been settled, not the full multidegree range.
